caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with a reddish-brown color, featuring two distinct sections on its front face. The upper section contains a square clock face with a pale background and Roman numerals marking the hours, with black hour and minute hands pointing to just past 8 o’clock. The corners of the clock face are decorated with small blue floral designs. The lower section features a square panel with a painting of a bouquet consisting of a red rose, a red tulip, a white tulip, and green leaves, set against a light blue background. The clock has a classical design with two columns flanking the sides and a stepped base and top. The entire clock is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Seth Thomas Clock
